# 1 Enoch Chapter 45 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**45:1** This is the Second Parable, concerning those who deny the name of the dwelling of the holy ones and the Lord of Spirits.

**45:2** Into heaven they shall not ascend, and upon the earth they shall not come — such is the lot of the sinners who have denied the name of the Lord of Spirits, who are thus preserved for the day of suffering and tribulation.

**45:3** On that day my Elect One shall sit upon the throne of glory and shall try their works, and their places of rest shall be innumerable. Their souls shall grow strong within them when they see my Elect One, and those who have called upon my glorious name.

**45:4** On that day I will cause my Elect One to dwell among them, and I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light.

**45:5** And I will transform the dry ground and make it a blessing, and I will cause my elect ones to dwell upon it; but the sinners and evildoers shall not set foot upon it.

**45:6** For I have provided and satisfied with peace my righteous ones, and have caused them to dwell before me; but for the sinners there is a judgment impending with me, so that I shall destroy them from the face of the earth.

---

*LOGOS notes: The Second Parable opens with God speaking in the first person for the first time in the Parables, claiming the Elect One as "my Elect One" (vv. 3–5). The enthronement of the Elect One (v. 3) is the most direct precursor in Second Temple literature to the NT Son of Man sayings.*
